title: Is There a Toilet on a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: On Chifbay's private trips, yes: there is a bathroom on board on both the Day Trip and the Sunset Trip. Not every small boat has one, so ask before you book.
heroAlt: An older woman and a child seen from behind under a boat canopy, Praia Formosa beach ahead

images.prompt: Late morning off Praia Formosa, just west of Funchal, Madeira. Taken from the stern of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking forward and to the side: in the shade of the canopy, a woman with white hair in a sun hat and a child of about seven in a cap sit side by side on the grey cushions, both seen from behind, looking towards the shore. Beyond them, across calm blue water, the long dark pebble beach of Praia Formosa and the tall hotels of the Lido on the slope above. Soft sun, true colours, no faces visible, no text.
